messages:
owen (Eng-Go): Heads-up: go-sdk v0.8.0 pushed a change that normalizes header keys to lowercase by default. This was intended to match net/http behavior but it looks like our quota-attribution pipeline relied on Title-Case headers (X-Rd-Route).

priya (Eng-Platform): Wait, we intentionally consume `X-Rd-Route` exact-casing in the routing proxy? I thought header lookup was case-insensitive at the gateway.

own (Eng-Go): The Gateway sees it fine (case-insensitive), but the quota reconciler job (kafka->lambda) reads raw headers from the internal envelope and blames difference in stored keys. Essentially, the reconciler's map keys were case-sensitive, so `x-rd-route` != `X-Rd-Route`. Result: 4% of quota attributions went to unknown buckets since midnight.

nora (Eng-Console): Yup, dashboard alert fired. We see a subtle drift in per-route spend where some routes show ~0 tokens but overall usage is steady. Ops alerted a few customers already.

jamie (DevEx): Any customers affected for Dedicated/private who vendor-fork the Go SDK? We should coordinate notices.

own (Eng-Go): This change was meant to make go-sdk consistent across OS. It slipped through review. I'm proposing a 0.8.1 hotfix that preserves header original-casing when setting custom headers: `SetHeaderPreserveCasing(true)` opt-in for now. Also produce a compatibility shim in platform that normalizes map keys to lowercase before reconciliation.

priya (Eng-Platform): Platform-side defensive fix is low-risk: in the reconciler we can canonicalize map keys to lower-case before lookup. But we should also add unit tests that assert case-insensitivity across the whole pipeline. I'll open a PR.

nora (Eng-Console): If platform fix is quick, we can revert dashboard alerts. Timeline?

priya (Eng-Platform): PR in flight. Expect review + merge in ~90m. I'll add a schema test to CI that replays a sample envelope with mixed-case headers.

jamie (DevEx): Go SDK hotfix timeline? We need a patch release and to update the release notes with guidance (enable opt-in or pin to 0.7.x).

own (Eng-Go): I can cut 0.8.1 in <2h with the opt-in flag defaulting to false. We'll publish a short migration note: "Go SDK 0.8.0 introduces header normalization; if you rely on header-casing for downstream tooling, pin to 0.7.x or enable SetHeaderPreserveCasing(true) in 0.8.1."

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-07-12-headers. Severity: P2. Notified: platform, console, go-eng.

priya (Eng-Platform): Long-term: we should standardize header keys in our internal envelope representation. Either always lowercase or store original and use case-insensitive lookups. Preference: canonical lowercase + keep original metadata for audits. I'll add a roadmap ticket.

jamie (DevEx): Also add a QA e2e: run sdk matrix (go/python/node) + reconciler job to catch these parity issues before release. Add to pre-release checklist.

nora (Eng-Console): I've adjusted the console alert to group by token hash instead of route for now so customers aren't spammed. Will revert when reconciler patch lands.

priya (Eng-Platform): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1998 - adds lowercase canonicalization + test.

own (Eng-Go): Draft PR for go-sdk: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/284 - opt-in preserve-casing + tests.

ops-bot: Platform patch deployed to canary cluster (priya). Monitoring: https://internal/infra/metrics/reconciler/canary :eyes:

jamie (DevEx): I'll coordinate a blurb for the changelog and ping Support to prep a short KB for Dedicated customers who might vendor.

nora (Eng-Console): Console shows attribution recovery on canary. Keeping eyes for 30m before escalations clear.

owen (Eng-Go): Thanks everyone. After platform change is merged and canary green, we'll publish 0.8.1 and docs. Apologies for the churn.

jamie (DevEx): No worries — great cross-team response. Closing when reconciler metrics stable > 1h.
